detail: Exposed agentStore.upsert() as twining_register tool (matching existing coordination tool patterns), created a dispatch skill to teach the protocol, added SubagentStop hook as safety net, and created twining-aware-worker agent template for subagents that use Twining directly. This bridges the gap between Agent tool dispatch and Twining coordination with minimal source changes (one new tool, ~40 lines).
summary: Add twining_register MCP tool and subagent coordination integration (dispatch skill, SubagentStop hook, aware-worker agent)
